description: Finds dated events (games, concerts, shows) at the venues in Park Graph's event network, each with its parking: q is the question in plain words ("Knicks game Friday", "Taylor Swift MetLife Nov 14"), with optional date or from and to, venue, and lat and lng. Dates in q (today, tomorrow, Friday, this weekend, Nov 14, 2026-11-14) are read in the venue's time zone. Each event lists bookable Park Graph lots within a mile (lots; each lot_id works with get_lot, the quote tool and reserve; event_price where the lot set one), lots nearby that take parking requests (request_lots, each with a request_url, where a driver leaves an email; not bookable) and the event's page (event_url). partner adds a partner key to every link. No API key needed. The top-level summary is a one-line, plain-language answer; an empty events list means no upcoming event matched. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

date.description: One day (YYYY-MM-DD), in place of a day in q

from.description: First day of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

lat.description: Latitude of a point; only venues within radius_km of it. Sent with lng

lng.description: Longitude of that point, sent with lat

partner.description: A Park Graph partner key (ptn_…), added to every link in the result

q.description: The event in plain words: team, performer, venue and day ("Knicks game Friday at MSG")

radius_km.description: Distance from lat and lng to the venue, in km

to.description: Last day of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

venue.description: A venue's name or page slug ("Madison Square Garden", "madison-square-garden")

name: search_events
title: Search events
